curriculumDefinition.commandsAndConcepts: No new command families. Return to completed work through focused drills, combine practised topics in mixed review, maintain them over time, and choose the mechanism before editing.
curriculumDefinition.learningOutcome: Use the existing Mastery map to revisit, combine, maintain, and deliberately choose among skills without changing the saved curriculum position.
curriculumDefinition.representativeExercises: Replay focused drills, complete interleaved mixed review, name a tool before touching the keys, pin topics for later practice, and consult batch and command-line field notes.
curriculumDefinition.priorityAndPortability: This unit is a durable practice surface rather than a new command lesson. Its first completed mixed review closes the story once; every session remains reusable afterward.

lessons.title: Keeper’s circuit
lessons.objective: Enter the reusable Mastery surface and complete one mixed review to establish the final chapter boundary.

activities.title: Return, combine, maintain
activities.body: Keeper’s Relay is not a finish line. Open Mastery, choose work you have already practised, and complete one mixed review. That first circuit closes this chapter; focused drills, tool-choice sessions, pins, progress states, and field notes remain available whenever you return.
